const sortNumbers = (numbers) => {
  const numberWords = [
    'zero',
    'one',
    'two',
    'three',
    'four',
    'five',
    'six',
    'seven',
    'eight',
    'nine'
  ];

  return numbers
    .split(' ')
    .filter(Boolean)
    .sort((a, b) => numberWords.indexOf(a) - numberWords.indexOf(b))
    .join(' ');
};
